# <span id="aanchor489"></span> Purge Meter Data

Use the Meter Purge screen to delete data from the database for meters in a list, or for individual meters. Purging will delete data from the following tables: periodic, batch, analysis, characteristics, events, edit reasons, alarms, exceptions, and final form data (hourly, daily, monthly).

After the data has been purged, the data will automatically be queued to rollup.

This is a very powerful utility that should be used carefully. A lot of important data can be deleted easily, especially if you purge data using the "All Date/Time" option. For this reason, you can only access Meter Purge if you have **Purge** \> **Open Meter Data** privileges on at least one system.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Meter Purge screen:

- Go to **Tools** \> **Purge** \> **Meter Data**; or

- Right-click an item in the Volume Editor and select **Purge**.

  The Meter Purge access from the Volume Editor is only available on the periodic, daily, monthly and batch tabs. When accessed from the Volume Editor, the form will pre-populate with the system, meter number, meter name, and selected date.

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Purge Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available on the Meter Purge screen:

- **System and Meter/List** - Select a system and the meter or list of meters.

- **Date Range** - Perform the purge for a contract month, contract day(s), date/time range, or all date/time.

  When “All Date/Time” is selected, FLOWCAL will populate the characteristic record with the latest available record for all of time.

  When “Date/Time Range” is selected, and the From and To time are set to beginning of time and end of time, FLOWCAL will populate the characteristic record with the first available record for all of time.

- **Keep Original Data** - Keep original data and only delete the edits. If you need to delete all data and re-import it, do not select this option.

  If you select this option, the Apply Autoedits and Apply Source options will also be available.

  This function requires **Purge** \> **Open Meter Data** privileges.

- **Apply Autoedits** - Apply auto edits automatically after purging edits.

- **Apply Source** - Apply the source analysis automatically after purging edits.

- **Purge PPA(s)** - Purge prior period adjustments only.

  This function requires **Purge** \> **PPA Meter Data** privileges.

- **Rescan** - Sends the purge time frame to SCADA request.

- **Keep Original Batch Configuration** - Keep the imported batch time frame(s).

</div>
